title: Agent / MCP Security Scanner input
description: Paste one or more AI agent / MCP client config files (JSON, JSONC, TOML, or YAML). The scanner is offline and read-only: it never launches MCP servers or calls remote endpoints with your config.

configText.title: Config content
configText.description: Paste a single config file body (mcp.json, Claude Desktop config, tools/list export, Codex TOML, etc.). Use Config filename below so the parser picks the right format.

configFileName.title: Config filename
configFileName.description: Logical filename for the pasted Config content (extension selects parser: .json / .toml / .yaml).

configFiles.title: Additional configs
configFiles.description: Optional list of extra configs, each with name + content. Use when scanning several files in one run.

outputFormat.title: Report format
outputFormat.description: Format of the report file written to the key-value store (key: REPORT).

failOn.title: Fail on severity
failOn.description: If any finding is at or above this severity, the Actor run ends with a failed status (useful in CI). Choose none to always succeed when the scan itself completed.

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity to report
minSeverity.description: Hide findings below this severity from the dataset and report.

rules.title: Only these rules
rules.description: Optional comma-separated rule ids (e.g. ASC010,ASC022). Empty = all rules.

ignore.title: Ignore rules
ignore.description: Optional comma-separated rule ids to skip.
